product.name: Crew Matrix Planning (CMP) Tool
product.description: An AI-powered tool for automatic real-time crew matrix planning and succession planning over 18 months.

product.name: Proteus
product.description: An AI-driven platform that connects to legacy maritime software to extract and analyze operational data for decision-making.

product.name: Ocean Oracle
product.description: A generative AI tool that enables users to query complex cargo and machinery operations manuals for relevant information.

product.name: SeaGPT
product.description: A generative AI assistant that enables crewing teams to interact with their data through natural language queries and automate administrative tasks.

product.name: Flotilla
product.description: A fleet management dashboard that provides real-time vessel tracking, crew nationality and travel data, and integration with maritime software.
